next.emptyText: When an inspection is assigned to you, it shows up here.

empty.day: You have no inspections on this day
empty.week: You have no inspections this week

hero.title: Book the inspection
hero.text: A PropertyScore inspector visits the home, looks carefully at every room and leaves you a clear book with photos. You only choose the day.
hero.reschedule: Reschedule for free up to 24 h before

help.requester: It tells us where to send the confirmations and the book.
help.home: The address, the pin on the map and a few details about the home.
help.date: The visit takes 1–2 hours. You can reschedule for free up to 24 hours before.
help.access: Tell us who lets the inspector in.
help.payment: The booking appears in your account as soon as you send it.

owner.title: I am the owner
owner.text: I am booking the inspection for my home. I get the full book and a free professional listing.

buyer.title: I am a buyer
buyer.text: I want to know the state of the home before I buy it. The owner picks the day, I pay afterwards.

signIn.title: Sign in to continue
signIn.text: The booking and the book go to your account. Once you sign in, we bring you back here.

home.title: For which home?
home.text: The homes in your account. Choose one or add another.
home.error: We could not load your homes.

note.reinspect: A new inspection updates the book and the badge.
note.badge: After the inspection, the listing gets the “Physically verified” badge.
note.listing: You also get a free professional listing, if you want one.

new.title: Add a new home
new.text: You fill in the address and the details in the next step.

picked.new: New home. You fill in the address in the next step.
picked.existing: You chose {{address}}. We already filled in the address and details; you check them in the next step.

address.title: Address
address.covered: We have inspectors in {{city}}. You can continue.

noCoverage.title: We have no inspectors in {{city}} yet
noCoverage.text: We do not ask you to pay anything. Come back soon: our team of inspectors grows every month.

pin.title: Pin on the map
pin.text: The inspector comes to exactly this point.
pin.mapError: The map could not load. Reload the page.
pin.empty: Tap the map to place the pin

details.title: About the home
details.text: It helps us estimate how long the visit takes.
details.areaHint: From the papers or the listing
details.floorHint: The floor and how many the building has

date.error: We could not load the free times.
date.timeHelpEmpty: First choose a day in the calendar.
date.pickedNote: The visit takes 1–2 hours · free rescheduling up to 24 hours before

taken.title: The chosen time was just booked, choose another
taken.text: We kept the day. The times still free are below.

noSlots.title: No free times left
noSlots.text: The inspectors in {{city}} are booked for the next 90 days. Come back in a few days.

self.title: I open it
self.text: We use the name and phone from your account.

other.title: Someone else
other.text: A family member, a neighbour or the agent.

access.name: Their name
access.notesPlaceholder: E.g. intercom 4, the dog stays on the balcony
access.callNote: The inspector calls 30 minutes before. If nobody answers, they wait 15 minutes.

payment.terms: I agree to the Terms and the Privacy Policy.
payment.termsNote: Cancelling is free up to 24 hours before.
payment.notActive: Online payment is not active yet: the booking is saved now, without payment.
payment.secure: Secure payment. We do not keep card details.

blocked.date: Choose a day and a time to continue

confirmation.title: The inspection is booked
confirmation.text: The booking is saved in your account. We let you know there when an inspector is assigned.

prep.rooms: Make every room, the balcony and the storage room accessible
prep.meters: Leave the electrical panel and the meters in view
prep.papers: Have the papers ready: land register extract and floor survey, if you have them
prep.heating: Turn on the heating and hot water an hour before
prep.worries: Write down what worries you, so the inspector checks it

appointments.inspectorPending: The inspector is assigned within 24 hours

empty.title: No bookings yet
empty.text: Book an inspection or start with the online report of the area.

drawer.title: Inspection · {{date}}
drawer.description: The booking details, its stages and what you can change.

appointments.locked: The inspection has taken place. It can no longer be rescheduled or cancelled.

reschedule.title: Choose the new date
reschedule.text: Free times in the city with an inspector available.
reschedule.textAssigned: If {{name}} is free at the new time, they stay your inspector; otherwise we assign another.

cancel.title: Cancel the inspection on {{date}}?
cancel.text: You have not paid anything, so there is nothing to refund. The time is freed for other clients.

schedule.description: Physical inspections: assign inspectors and follow the calendar.

empty.title: No inspections to assign
empty.text: Every booking has an inspector. New ones show up here.

noMatch.title: No inspections for these filters
noMatch.text: Change the city or the day.

noInspectors.title: No inspectors
noInspectors.text: Change the city or the inspector in the filters.

ghost.busy: Already has an inspection at this time
ghost.unavailable: Does not work at this time

dnd.instructions: Press space to pick up the inspection, the arrow keys to move it onto an inspector’s column and space to drop it. Escape cancels.

drawer.description: The booking details, the inspector, rescheduling and cancelling.

cancel.title: Cancel inspection PS-I-{{number}}
cancel.text: Online payment is not active, so there is nothing to refund. The client sees the reason in their account.

availability.description: The hours when <name>{{name}}</name> can take new bookings, every week.

empty.title: No inspectors yet
empty.text: Make a user an inspector on the Users page.
